mapper.sql: (s.origin = 'REGISTERED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_registration r WHERE r.source_id = s.id AND r.state <> 'WITHDRAWN'))
mapper.select: INSERT INTO source_sample (source_id, route, articles, with_abstract, names_per_article, act_share, taxgroups, error) VALUES (#{o.sourceId}, #{o.route}, #{o.articles}, #{o.withAbstract}, #{o.namesPerArticle}, #{o.actShare}, #{o.taxgroups, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{o.error}) RETURNING id
SELECT * FROM source_sample WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM source_sample WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT FROM source s WHERE s.id = #{sourceId}), false)
SELECT s.id, AS registered FROM source s WHERE ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id FROM source s WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_sample x WHERE x.source_id = s.id AND x.sampled_at > #{sampledBefore}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.type = 'SAMPLE_SOURCE' AND t.state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND t.payload ->> 'sourceId' = s.id::text) ORDER BY DESC, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_sample x2 WHERE x2.source_id = s.id) DESC, s.candidate_score DESC NULLS LAST, s.id LIMIT #{limit}
